subject.title: fix(ci): extend frozen target hook timeout

question: Should frozen compatibility-target release validation accept a five-minute Vitest hook timeout in exchange for avoiding cold-run false failures?
rationale: The code correctly confines the behavior to frozen compatibility targets, but the acceptable fail-fast duration for release validation is an operational policy choice that automated review cannot make.

options.title: Accept the scoped timeout
options.body: Merge the compatibility-target-only five-minute hook timeout after required checks complete, accepting up to three additional minutes for a truly stuck hook.

options.title: Keep the current fail-fast window
options.body: Do not merge this change and continue treating cold-hook timeout retries as release-validation failures until a different reliability approach is chosen.

recommendation.title: Accept the scoped timeout
recommendation.body: Merge the compatibility-target-only five-minute hook timeout after required checks complete, accepting up to three additional minutes for a truly stuck hook.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history ties this contributor directly to the proposed CI and release-validation change.
